player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({role}) in a {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies game.
- Each round, submit [heads] or [tails] (or [h], [t]).
- If your choice matches your opponent’s, Player 0 wins the round; otherwise Player 1 wins.
Reply with your choice in the format '[heads]' or '[tails]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format invalidu; si prega di submit '[heads]' o '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Player 0 hà sceltu {choice0}; Player 1 hà sceltu {choice1}. Match -> Player 0 vinci
message.round_mismatch: Player 0 hà sceltu {choice0}; Player 1 hà sceltu {choice1}. Mismatch -> Player 1 vinci.
